data.name: Cli_RootDescription
data.value: QuickER - a CLI that generates C# code from an ER diagram or database

data.name: Cli_Opt_Schema
data.value: Input ER diagram JSON file (the app's save format)

data.name: Cli_Opt_Out
data.value: Output folder for the generated code

data.name: Cli_Opt_Config
data.value: Generation option settings file (quicker.json)

data.name: Cli_Cmd_Generate
data.value: Generate C# code from an ER diagram JSON

data.name: Cli_Opt_Connection
data.value: Connection string (e.g. Server=.;Database=Foo;Integrated Security=true;TrustServerCertificate=true)

data.name: Cli_Opt_CommandTimeout
data.value: Timeout in seconds for each schema import statement (0 = no limit)

data.name: Cli_Cmd_Scaffold
data.value: Connect directly to a database and generate C# code from its schema

data.name: Cli_Opt_Provider
data.value: Target database type (default: sqlserver)

data.name: Cli_Opt_SplitFilesByCategory
data.value: Output each category in a separate file and namespace (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_LayeredOutput
data.value: Split generated files into per-layer subfolders (Domain / Presentation / Infrastructure / Server); implies --split-files-by-category (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_DomainLayerDirectory
data.value: Domain layer folder for layered output, relative to --out (default: Domain; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_PresentationLayerDirectory
data.value: Presentation layer folder for layered output, relative to --out (default: Presentation; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_InfrastructureLayerDirectory
data.value: Infrastructure layer folder for layered output, relative to --out (default: Infrastructure; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_ServerLayerDirectory
data.value: Server layer folder for layered output, relative to --out; only used with remote services (default: Server; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_RootNamespace
data.value: Root namespace of the generated code (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_RuntimeNamespace
data.value: Namespace for the shared runtime (fixed code) when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_EntityNamespace
data.value: Namespace for Entity classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_EditModelNamespace
data.value: Namespace for EditModel classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_MapperNamespace
data.value: Namespace for Mapper classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_RepositoryNamespace
data.value: Namespace for Repository classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_ValueObjectNamespace
data.value: Namespace for value object classes when splitting by category (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateEditModels
data.value: Generate EditModel classes (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateMappers
data.value: Generate Mapper classes (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateValueObjects
data.value: Generate a value object type per column (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_UseGuidKeyForStringPrimaryKey
data.value: Turn string primary keys into GuidKey value objects (only when value objects are generated; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateRepositories
data.value: Generate QuickER Repositories (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_RepositoryDialects
data.value: Dialects for which to also generate QuickER Repositories (comma-separated, multiple allowed; e.g. sqlserver,sqlite). When omitted, a single dialect is derived from --provider. Overrides the settings file.

data.name: Cli_Opt_ExcludeUnboundedBinaryColumns
data.value: Exclude unbounded binary columns (varbinary(max), BLOB without a length) from the generated Repository's SELECT/UPDATE; INSERT keeps all columns (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateEfCore
data.value: Generate EF Core code (QuickErDbContext and EF Core Repositories) (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateInMemoryRepositories
data.value: Generate in-memory Repository implementations for testing (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateSyncSupport
data.value: Generate the bidirectional sync support for a server (SQL Server) plus local (SQLite) setup (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateRemoteContracts
data.value: Additionally generate remote-capable Repository interfaces I{Entity}RemoteRepository (CRUD, save, named queries only; I{Entity}Repository keeps all methods and inherits it) (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateRemoteServices
data.value: Include the HTTP client implementation of the remote surface in the main output, and additionally output an ASP.NET Core server implementation to {baseName}.RemoteServer.g.cs (implies the remote surface --generate-remote-contracts automatically; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_UseRuntimePackages
data.value: Do not include the runtime (fixed code) in the generated code; rely on references to the NuGet packages QuickER.Runtime.* instead (can be combined with EF Core generation; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_GenerateApiDocs
data.value: Additionally output one API reference Markdown ({baseName}.g.md) (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_IncludeJapaneseApiDocs
data.value: Also output the Japanese API reference Markdown ({base}.ja.g.md; requires --generate-api-docs) (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_ApiDocsDirectory
data.value: Output subfolder for the API reference Markdown, relative to the output directory (e.g. docs; blank = the output directory itself; requires --generate-api-docs) (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_ApiDocsFileName
data.value: File name for the API reference Markdown (the extension is normalized to .g.md; the Japanese version reuses the base name; blank = derived from the output file name, or ApiDocs.g.md when files are split; requires --generate-api-docs) (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_IncludeDataAnnotations
data.value: Add DataAnnotations and DB-definition meta attributes ([Required], [MaxLength], [DbTableMeta], etc.) (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_IncludeJsonIgnoreOnParentNavigation
data.value: Add [JsonIgnore] to parent-reference navigations (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_OutputPath
data.value: Output file name for single-file output; only the file name part is used and the output directory is always --out (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_InvalidBooleanFlag

data.value: Start a stdio MCP server that exposes ER diagram editing and code generation tools for AI agents (communicates over stdin/stdout using JSON-RPC; each tool takes the target diagram file as its 'file' argument)
